lines.zh: 我沿着村道跑，脚不沾雪。
lines.en: I run the village road, feet barely touching snow.

lines.zh: 在夜晚的针叶林中穿梭
lines.en: Moving through the pine forest at night

lines.zh: 爪子陷进雪里，悄无声息。
lines.en: My paws sink into the snow without a sound.

lines.zh: 我沿着村道边的林子跑。
lines.en: I run the treeline beside the village road.

lines.zh: 松脂的味道盖住了我的气味。
在夜晚的针叶林中徘徊
lines.en: Wandering through the pine forest at night
Enjoying the warmth of the moon

lines.zh: 我在雪堆上蹭掉爪缝的血。
lines.en: I scrape blood from between my claws in the snow.

lines.zh: 耳朵转着，听村里的狗叫。
lines.en: Ears turning, I listen to the village dogs.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，把影子藏树后。
lines.en: I crouch low and hide my shadow behind a trunk.

lines.zh: 皮毛上的雪慢慢化开了。
lines.en: The snow on my fur slowly melts.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔牙缝，尝到铁味。
lines.en: I lick my teeth and taste iron.

lines.zh: 月亮偏西了，我还不想走。
lines.en: The moon has moved west; I am not leaving yet.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我的爪印很新。
lines.en: In the taiga, my paw prints are fresh.

lines.zh: 我蹲在矮枝上，尾巴不动。
lines.en: I crouch on a low branch, tail still.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，我就换个姿势。
lines.en: Each time you move, I shift my stance.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我比你熟每道兽径。
lines.en: I know every game trail in these pines.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在冷空气里成雾。
lines.en: My breath fogs in the cold air.

lines.zh: 我歪头，看你有没有带武器。
lines.en: I tilt my head to see if you are armed.

lines.zh: 毛竖起来，又慢慢趴下去。
lines.en: My hackles rise, then slowly settle.
I rise on my hind legs to look at you.
I howl once and my legs give out.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把嚎叫吞回去。
lines.en: I bite down and swallow the howl.

lines.zh: 我倒进雪里，血把雪染黑。
lines.en: I fall into snow, blood staining it dark.

lines.zh: 饥饿的呼唤引诱着你靠近。
lines.en: The call of hunger draws you near.
Come closer, and you'll get more.
The meat in your hand is frozen stiff.

lines.zh: 别想逃跑，你会成为我的。
lines.en: You won't get away, you'll be mine.
Come to me, I give strength.
Tempt you, make the prey more delicious.
We have a battle to fight.

lines.zh: 我被撞开，立刻又扑回来。
lines.en: Knocked aside, I spring right back.

lines.zh: 我的肩一沉，从你肋下钻过。
lines.en: I drop my shoulder and slip under your guard.
Knock past you, then into the village.

lines.zh: 你的力量不足以打败我。
lines.en: Your strength is not enough to defeat me.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我的爪子先落地。
lines.en: In the taiga, my claws land first.

lines.zh: 雪地上的气味，通向另一个狼窝。
lines.en: The scent in the snow leads to another den.

lines.zh: 与我共舞，成为我的伴侣。
lines.en: Dance with me, be my partner.

lines.zh: 我在找一个能跟上我的。
lines.en: I am looking for one who can keep up.

lines.zh: 我的力量在你体内觉醒。

lines.en: Join with me, enhance your power.
The prey in the woods is mine.

lines.zh: 我叼起一只冻僵的兔子。
lines.en: I pick up a frozen rabbit.

lines.zh: 夜晚是最好的猎食时间。
lines.en: Night is the best hunting time.
Deep in the coniferous forest is my home.
In the taiga I run the lightest.
Humans in the village taste good.
I pick the hand holding your weapon.
The village will be one short tonight.

lines.zh: 雪地里，我的脚印绕了半圈。
lines.en: My tracks circle half round in the snow.
Targeted, double kill with one shot.

lines.zh: 我在雪上压低身子前进。
lines.en: I creep forward low over the snow.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸变成一团团白气。
lines.en: My breath turns to puffs of white.
My hind legs coil to leap.

lines.zh: 它的牙齿深深嵌入肉中！
lines.en: Its teeth sink deep into the flesh!

lines.zh: 它的利爪划过你的肌肤！
lines.en: Its claws slice across your skin!
Appears in the dead of night!

lines.zh: 雪停了，我从林子里走出。
lines.en: The snow stops and I step out of the trees.

lines.zh: 针叶上的积雪抖落，我现身。
lines.en: Snow slides off the pines and I appear.

lines.zh: 篝火的烟把我引到村边。
lines.en: Campfire smoke led me to the village edge.
The night is right; I come out.
Fire in my fur — I dive into the snow.

lines.zh: 从树冠摔下，我摔了个滚。
lines.en: I tumble down from the canopy.

lines.zh: 嚎叫着倒下，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: howling in pain — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀进针叶堆里。
lines.en: The blast threw me into the pine needles.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我跑得比狼快。
lines.en: In the taiga I outrun the wolves.

lines.zh: 受伤了，呜呜叫，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: whining in pain — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有树，也没有村庄。
lines.en: No trees and no village in the void.
